title: Doctored Yellow Cake with Chocolate Frosting
summary: A boxed yellow cake made extra moist and buttery, poured with glossy chocolate frosting.
difficulty_reason: Box mix with a few swaps; whisk, bake, pour frosting.

ingredients.line: 1 box yellow or butter recipe cake mix

steps: Heat the oven to 315°F, not the 350°F on the box.
Whisk the cake mix, eggs, melted butter, milk and vanilla in a large bowl until smooth.
Pour the batter into a greased baking dish.
Bake about 36 to 37 minutes in the smaller square pan, or 27 to 29 minutes in a 9x13 pan, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Microwave the frosting 15 to 20 seconds and stir until pourable but not hot.
Pour the frosting over the cooled cake and spread to the corners with a knife.
Let the frosting set, then cut into squares.
tips: Frost only when the cake is fully cool, and keep the frosting just pourable: too hot and it tears the top.
The lower 315°F oven keeps the crumb tender.
